notes.title: Warriors All-Stars crossovers with Dead Or Alive, Ninja Gaiden, and more
notes.notes: Having previously predicted that Omega Force’s Warriors games are on a path to create hack ‘n’ slash adaptations of all fictional and historical stories, I feel vindicated to see that they’re now rolling a load of video games into one Warriors game. Publishers Koei Tecmo today announced a PC release for Warriors All-Stars [official site], a game throwing together characters from Warriors games along with Dead Or Alivers, Ninjas Gaiden, and other Tecmo stars. I’m telling you, 20 years from now Omega Force will release a game based on the English Parliament. Put money on it. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Update Information 1.0.3 (2017/03/31)
notes.notes:
■Update Details

The following improvement was made:

The setting "Region locking when searching for a multiplayer room" was added to the launcher.
When searching for a multiplayer room, you can set whether to restrict the search to your download region.
Setting this to "OFF" enables you to be matched with users throughout the world; however, depending on your communication environment, you might experience issues such as lagging.

notes.title: Toukiden 2 brings more monster-hunting to PC
notes.notes: Omega Force are back with more Monster Hunter-ish action in Toukiden 2 [official site], released today. It’s an open-world hack ‘n’ slash action-RPG set in a Japanese medieval fantasy world, where players need to roam around around murdering giant demons by hacking off bodyparts. It’s the small pleasures in life. Here, have a peek in this trailer: … [visit site to read more]

The latest installment in the hunting action series "Toukiden". From the battlefield to the village that serves as your base of operations, the game takes place in a vast "open world". Explore the vast world for yourself, and enjoy hunting action from an entirely new perspective.
